title: 003 — Schema mode: with a predictable key set, store N alone

sections.title: P1–P3 — full records: round trip, size, operations

legend.floor: packed size m·⌈log₂ V⌉ bits, V = 1,000
legend.frac_bits: N and D stored, as in proof 001
legend.holding: every x = 1, 38, 75, …; records include empty roles

findings.label: P1–P3
findings.value: with the key set known, N alone round-trips every record at 1.01× the packed size m·⌈log₂ V⌉ for 10 roles and 1.20× for 1,000, half of fraction mode; merge of disjoint records and the value query survive

sections.title: P4 — sparse key sets: the cheapest encoding of the keys

legend.d_bits: the product of the keys, as fraction mode stores it
legend.gamma_bits: Elias-γ codes of the gaps between dictionary positions
legend.bitmap_bits: one presence bit per dictionary entry (U = 20,000)

findings.label: P4
findings.value: D is the cheapest key-set encoding only for very sparse memories (10 keys of 20,000); a gap code wins from about 100 keys, a bitmap when nearly half the dictionary is present
